veranderings.voor: 'n stuk land met water heeltemal rondom
veranderings.na: 'n stuk land met water reg rondom
veranderings.rede: 'Reg rondom' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for 'all the way around'; 'heeltemal rondom' reads stiffly, and the meaning (completely surrounded) is kept.

veranderings.voor: 'n stuk water met land heeltemal rondom
veranderings.na: 'n stuk water met land reg rondom
veranderings.rede: Same idiom as the island sentence, so the paired definitions stay parallel in wording.

veranderings.voor: en daarom lewe daar baie soorte dinge
veranderings.na: en daarom is daar baie soorte lewende dinge
veranderings.rede: 'Dinge' alone is vague; 'lewende dinge' is the usual Grade 4 science term and avoids the odd 'dinge lewe' without changing the meaning.
